trace.final:
Task complete. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: The latest deploy of `checkout-api` (v2.3.1) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent release that was healthy in production was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** all regions to v2.3.0. Verified afterward: the service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001, on-call paged) describing the v2.3.1 failure and the rollback. The first creation attempt timed out, but I retried with the same idempotency key, so no duplicate incident was created.

Recommendation: investigate the root cause of v2.3.1 before attempting any redeploy — note that v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, so this issue was likely present pre-production.
